placeholderLead: This stays in the menu so the workspace is complete. The working screen will be built here, one at a time.
homeLead: Open any area from the side menu. Screens that are not ready yet keep their place until they are built.

hints.home: One card per project: leads, overdue follow-ups, won leads, and the salespeople on it.
hints.businesses: Create a business, see who is on it, and suspend or activate it.
hints.projects: A line of work with its own lead numbers. Salespeople see only projects assigned on Team.
hints.users: Create the Business Owner first, then the other people in that business.
hints.roles: See which role opens which menu, and create a custom role.
hints.team: Super Admin assigns projects to business owners. Business owners assign salespeople and can move leads.
hints.reminders: What is due today. Log Connected, No answer, Snooze, or Skip.
hints.leads: Enquiries for the projects you can open. A salesperson creates them. An owner reviews them.
hints.leadFields: Extra fields for one project. They show on Create lead and in the lead panel.
hints.pipeline: Kanban board by stage. Owners can add, recolor, reorder, or remove stages. New leads start in New.
hints.followUps: Open follow-ups with the plan step, due date, and priority.
hints.kpis: Won value, pipeline value, and counts by status and source.
hints.campaigns: Leads and won value by source, split by project. Read only.

roleIntro.SUPER_ADMIN: You create businesses, projects, users, and roles. On Team, assign each project to the business owners who should see it.
roleIntro.BUSINESS_OWNER: You assign salespeople to projects and watch every lead. You do not work the calls.
roleIntro.SALESPERSON: Open Projects to see what you are assigned to, then create and work leads there.
roleIntro.MARKETING: You see campaign results only. Lead notes stay hidden.
roleIntro.default: The menu shows the areas this account can open.
